# Observability and Replay {#sec-observability-replay}

::: {.callout-note title="Outline scaffold"}

This page makes the agreed chapter architecture renderable in Quarto. It records the chapter question, planned coverage, and intended systems outcome; full manuscript prose, figures, worked examples, fallacies, and exercises remain to be developed.

:::

## Chapter Question {.unnumbered}

_What evidence must a system retain to explain and debug a trajectory after the fact?_

## Planned Coverage

- Trace identity across model calls, tools, state, and policy decisions
- Structured events, state snapshots, and causal ordering
- Replay envelopes and nondeterministic dependencies
- Privacy-aware logging and retention
- Trajectory comparison and failure localization

## Intended Systems Outcome

Readers should be able to define an observability schema that supports diagnosis without falsely promising exact replay.
